info.name: SilaApi - Mobile
info.description:
Sign-in and calls for the mobile app through SilaApi (https://sila.glcpaints.com:7400).

1. Set the collection variables `username` and `password` (Variables tab). Never save a real password in a shared copy of this collection.
2. Run **Login**: its test script saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken` into the collection variables.
3. The other requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. The access token lasts about 5 minutes; run **Refresh** to get a new one.

The user is never sent: SilaApi takes it from the token. Do not send `User`, `IP` or `SqlStatement`; other procedure parameters go in `extraParams`.

exec: if (body.mustChangePassword) console.warn('This account must change its password before calling /api/v2/exec.');

request.description:
Response 200:
```json
{
  "accessToken": "eyJ...",
  "refreshToken": "...",
  "tokenType": "Bearer",
  "expiresAt": "2026-10-22T10:05:00Z",
  "sessionExpiresAt": "...",
  "database": "SILA101",
  "username": "mhd",
  "displayName": "...",
  "mustChangePassword": false
}
```
401 = wrong username or password; 429 = more than 10 attempts a minute from this IP. Unknown body fields are rejected (400).
Returns a new access token AND a new refresh token; the old refresh token stops working. Store both.

First call with maxSeq 0 = the full list; the test script then saves the highest SynSequence into {{maxSeq}}, so the next call returns only the conversations that changed (set maxSeq back to 0 for a full list again).

Result sets: data.List0 = ApplicationTableVersion, data.List1 = SoftwareVersionHistory, data.List2 = the conversations (V_SilaHistory_1 + ForceFullSync), data.List3 = notifications. A refusal comes back as HTTP 422 {ok:false, state, message} with no data: state 3 = 'Kindly update your App' (AndroidVersion / IOSVersion below SoftwareVersionHistory), 9 = user not active.

Note: if UserSyncMaster.ForceFullSync is set, the procedure ignores MaxSeq once and returns everything (ForceFullSync = 1 on the rows).

exec: if (!body.ok) { console.warn('Refused: state ' + body.state + ' - ' + body.message + (body.state === 3 ? ' (raise AndroidVersion / IOSVersion)' : '')); return; }
// Every APIGeneralOperation call returns ApplicationTableVersion (List0) and
// SoftwareVersionHistory (List1) first; 'Left side' rows are List2, notifications List3.
const top = rows.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, Number(r.SynSequence) || 0), Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('maxSeq')) || 0);
console.log(rows.length + ' conversation row(s); maxSeq now ' + top);

request.description: Returns {ticket, expiresAt}. One use, valid 30 s. Open the socket with a Postman WebSocket request: wss://sila.glcpaints.com:7400/api/v2/live?ticket=<ticket>. Frames: hello, presence, changed {seq, items:[{kind, id, silaId, seq}]}; send {"type":"ping"} to get pong.
Ends the session (204) and closes its sockets. To also drop the Firebase token, call APIGeneralOperation 'Logout' with PlatForm first.
